title: Decoding a circuit with its variable bound
statement: Given a Boolean list, first decode its initial unary natural number $n$, then read a circuit tree on $n$ variables from the remaining list. Return the resulting pair only if the reader consumes the entire remainder and re-encoding the pair gives exactly the original Boolean list; otherwise return no result.
